Photograph: Adam Burakowski/East News/Shutterstock View image in fullscreen The 55.6-metre statue of the Virgin Mary towers over the village of Konotopie, Poland. Photograph: Adam Burakowski/East News/Shutterstock Poland Europe’s tallest Virgin Mary statue unveiled in small Polish village Hundreds watched the 56-metre monument’s consecration, including anti-communist leader Lech Wałęsa Associated Press Sun 16 Aug 2026 11.00 EDT Last modified on Sun 16 Aug 2026 14.19 EDT Share Prefer the Guardian on Google An enormous statue of the Virgin Mary that is believed to be Europe’s tallest was inaugurated on Saturday in a small Polish village, in the presence of the anti-communist leader Lech Wałęsa. Hundreds of people took part in the consecration of the monument, which towers 55.6 metres (182ft) over Konotopie in central Poland , a village of fewer than 150 people. While helicopters scattered miniature red roses over the crowd, priests in white robes celebrated mass and the Mazowsze folk ensemble sang and danced to traditional Polish music. The statue is taller – if less dramatically located – than the Christ the Redeemer statue in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, which measures 38 metres including its pedestal. The Polish monument’s height includes a crown-shaped 15-metre pedestal. It also surpasses another large-scale religious monument in Poland, the Christ the King statue in the western town of Świebodzin, which was revealed in 2010 and, with the mound it stands on, is 52.5 metres tall. There is a taller statue of the Virgin Mary in the Philippines, which measures 98 metres. But the new one in Poland is believed to be the largest of its kind in Europe. View image in fullscreen The statue was paid for by a wealthy couple who live nearby. Photograph: Agnieszka Bielecka/EPA Wałęsa, who won the Nobel peace prize for his leadership of the Polish anti-communist resistance as the head of the Solidarity trade union and was later Poland’s president, had a front-row seat during the inauguration ceremony. “This is the end of my path,” said Wałęsa, 82, suggesting the causes he had long championed, including democracy and the Catholic faith, were now completed. “I started with the Virgin Mary and I end with the Virgin Mary.” During his Solidarity days, Wałęsa famously wore a Black Madonna pin and he has often credited his faith in God with giving him the strength to fight against communism. Most Poles identify as Catholic. The church played a powerful role in public life after the fall of communism in 1989, benefiting from the prestige it earned through its support of the anti-communist opposition. The country is the homeland of Saint John Paul II, who was pope from 1978 until his death in 2005. A huge statue of him – but much smaller than the one of Mary – was revealed more than a decade ago in the city of Częstochowa. The influence of religion in public life has gradually declined in recent years, particularly among younger people and in urban areas. However, the Catholic church remains influential, especially in rural communities and among older generations. skip past newsletter promotion Free newsletter | Every day Sign up to Headlines Europe A digest of the morning's main headlines from the Europe edition emailed direct to you every week day after newsletter promotion Wiesław Mering, a Polish Roman Catholic prelate who attended the ceremony, said: “I cannot help but notice the weakening of the institution of the church, a withdrawal of specific social categories from Catholicism, and this hurts me. The history of Christianity has ups and downs, but this place is a reminder that Mary won’t give up on Poland.” View image in fullscreen Visitors descend from the viewing platform inside the statue. Photograph: Adam Burakowski/East News/Shutterstock The statue was commissioned by Roman Karkosik, a wealthy Polish businessman, and his wife, Grażyna. The couple live in a small palace a few miles from Konotopie. Roman Karkosik, an entrepreneur whose ventures included plastic bottle manufacturing in the 1990s, amassed a fortune through investments on the Warsaw stock exchange to become one of Poland’s wealthiest individuals. The couple have said the monument is an expression of their gratitude to God. “The statue will be for all people,” Grażyna Karkosik said. “Each of us coming to see it will think more deeply about their own lives, not only about God.” Local authorities hope the monument will become an important pilgrimage site and a tourist destination. The statue has a viewing platform built inside its pedestal. Afghanistan Taliban threaten former Afghan police worker after MoD leak reveals identity UK has refused resettlement application despite ‘years of loyal service’ that have resulted in ‘constant fear’ of reprisals Haroon Siddique Legal affairs correspondent Sun 16 Aug 2026 09.00 EDT Last modified on Sun 16 Aug 2026 10.52 EDT Share Prefer the Guardian on Google A man has received threats from the Taliban after his work for the Afghan police was revealed by a Ministry of Defence leak and the UK refused his application for resettlement. Hamid* worked for the Afghan national police special unit and received certificates for his work signed by senior British figures praising his “dedication, unparalleled service and leadership”. His details were also included in an accidental 2022 leak by an MoD official that identified 18,700 Afghans who had worked with or for the British government. Hamid said he had received a number of threats from the Taliban , including a video he shared with the Guardian in which a man cradling a rifle and sitting below a Taliban flag threatens to pursue him and cites knowledge of his previous movements. View image in fullscreen Taliban security personnel in Kandahar. It is nearly five years since the group retook political power in Afghanistan. Photograph: Sanaullah Seiam/AFP/Getty Images The MoD, however, has rejected his application for resettlement under the Afghan relocations and assistance policy (Arap) scheme. His most recent rejection, received on 31 July, stated that Hamid had not provided evidence of “working alongside, in partnership with or closely supporting a UK government department”. It gave him 28 days to appeal. Hamid said: “This is extremely painful because I have already submitted every document available to me proving my service. Furthermore, many of my former colleagues who served in exactly the same department and performed the same duties have already been relocated to the UK through the Arap scheme. “Despite this evidence, my case continues to be refused. I believe my case raises serious questions about how some former Afghan partners of the UK continue to be treated despite years of loyal service.” Hamid’s plea for help comes five years after the Taliban retook power in Afghanistan on 15 August 2021 after the withdrawal of US and Nato forces. The UK government launched the Arap scheme on 1 April 2021 and closed it to new applications on 1 July last year. Pre-existing applications continue to be processed. View image in fullscreen Hamid lives in hiding and says the emotional impact has been ‘devastating’. Under Arap, high risk of death or serious injury are only taken into account if the rest of the criteria are deemed to have been met, which they have not in Hamid’s case. “Must I wait until I am captured, tortured or killed by the Taliban before my service and the danger I face are finally recognised?” he said. Abbas fought the Taliban alongside US and Australian troops. Now exiled in Iran, he feels abandoned Read more “Following the Ministry of Defence data breach, my personal information was exposed, placing me at even greater risk. Since then, my life has changed completely. I cannot safely leave my home to work. I live in constant fear of being recognised or targeted.” After the leak, the then defence secretary, John Healey, said the dataset included people who had made speculative applications under Arap and had not worked with British forces. He said being included in the leak “ doesn’t give them a right to claim access to Britain ”. “It doesn’t give them a right to claim asylum. It doesn’t make them eligible for the special [Arap] scheme that Britain put in place for those who’d worked alongside or served with our forces,” he said. Hamid said that because he was in hiding he had no reliable income and relied on his wife, who supports the family by doing small jobs from home. “This is our family’s only source of income, and even then we struggle simply to survive,” he said. “The emotional impact has been devastating. My wife and I have become deeply exhausted, depressed and hopeless after years of fear, uncertainty, repeated refusals and financial hardship. “I am not asking for special treatment. I am only asking for a fair review based on the evidence I have already provided.” An MoD spokesperson said: “Each application is considered on a case-by-case basis, assessed against the evidence provided, such as how they supported the UK mission in Afghanistan , and in line with the publicly available eligibility criteria. “Since the Taliban takeover, the UK has resettled almost 39,000 Afghan men, women and children through Afghan resettlement schemes.” Name has been changed Explore more on these topics Afghanistan Taliban Ministry of Defence South and central Asia news Share Reuse this content Most viewed Most viewed World Europe US news Americas Asia Australia Middle East Africa Inequality Global development

https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2026.text: Arron Banks reportedly used Precision Risk and Intelligence, a firm he previously owned, to investigate the Tory chair. Photograph: Tayfun Salcı/Zuma Press/Rex/Shutterstock View image in fullscreen Arron Banks reportedly used Precision Risk and Intelligence, a firm he previously owned, to investigate the Tory chair. Photograph: Tayfun Salcı/Zuma Press/Rex/Shutterstock Arron Banks Arron Banks hired private investigators to dig into Conservative party chair Revelation comes after it was disclosed that Reform UK backer had paid for spying on prominent journalist Rowena Mason Whitehall editor Sun 16 Aug 2026 12.00 EDT Last modified on Sun 16 Aug 2026 12.36 EDT Share Prefer the Guardian on Google The businessman and Reform UK backer Arron Banks commissioned a private intelligence firm to dig into the Conservative party chair, in addition to having paid for an investigation into a prominent journalist. Banks, a former Reform UK candidate and leave campaign donor, appeared to confirm on Sunday that he was behind an investigation into Kevin Hollinrake. The use of private investigators to look into Hollinrake was first reported by the Mail on Sunday, which said Banks had used Precision Risk and Intelligence, a firm he previously owned. As party chair, Hollinrake has led the Conservatives’ response to revelations about Nigel Farage’s finances, asking questions about the £5m undeclared gift Farage received from the Thailand-based crypto billionaire Christopher Harborne before the last election. Hollinrake addressed Banks on social media on Sunday, saying: “When you can’t answer the questions, investigate the people asking them. After we called for scrutiny of Reform UK’s finances, a close associate of Nigel Farage reportedly hired private investigators to dig into me (and journalists covering the same story).” In a reply on X, Banks said: “I’ve always come across people in this world who like to give it but can’t receive it.” Pressed on whether Reform knew about the surveillance, Banks suggested he had acted alone, saying: “I row my own boat.” Banks has been approached by the Guardian for comment. View image in fullscreen Kevin Hollinrake has been leading the Conservatives’ response to revelations about Nigel Farage’s finances. Photograph: Tayfun Salcı/Zuma Press/Rex/Shutterstock The developments come after it emerged previously in the New Statesman that Banks had commissioned Precision Risk to investigate Gabriel Pogrund, the investigations editor of the Sunday Times. The revelation led to fears that other journalists examining the funding of Reform and Farage, including those at the Guardian, could have been targeted. When asked previously whether he had commissioned investigators to surveil reporters at the Guardian, Banks said he was “not really interested in the Guardian” but declined to comment further. The News Media Association (NMA), which represents regional and national media, raised concerns and described it as an “attack on our democracy”. The Guardian, along with the Sunday Times, has broken a series of stories in recent months revealing how cash has been given to Reform and Farage personally from donors and wealthy benefactors. Theo Bamber, the chief executive of the NMA, said aggressive attempts to deter journalistic inquiry were at risk of becoming normalised. He said: “Using private investigators to try to deter journalists from making legitimate inquiries about public figures is an attack on our democracy. Sadly, intimidation and abuse of local and national journalists is increasingly used as a weapon to limit scrutiny and deflect attention away from matters of public interest. This must not become normalised. “Ministers must wake up to this threat to our democracy and do much more to protect the independent journalism which underpins our democratic way of life.” skip past newsletter promotion Free newsletter | Every weekday Sign up to First Edition Our morning email breaks down the key stories of the day, telling you what’s happening and why it matters after newsletter promotion Banks previously told the New Statesman: “We believe the Sunday Times used hacked information and that was an area of interest. We do have an investigative arm that’s got advanced capabilities.” The Sunday Times has rejected Banks’s suggestion. Banks, when asked directly by the New Statesman whether he had paid investigators to look into Pogrund, responded: “When you live by the sword, you die by the sword.” The Sunday Times published a new investigation this weekend into links between Reform funders and Tether.bet, a website accused of illegally offering gambling to UK punters, which closed this week. The newspaper said the convicted fraudster George Cottrell was a high-profile customer of the website, and Harborne owned a company, IFX, that processed payments on behalf of another company that took deposits and returned winnings. Cottrell’s lawyers told the newspaper his relationship with Tether.bet “has been limited to that of a customer, in addition to which he knows and is friends with the owner”. When contacted by the Guardian, Cottrell’s lawyers said he was one of the world’s best-known professional gamblers. “It is therefore hardly surprising that [others] may seek to associate themselves with him in an attempt to lend credibility to their businesses or generate publicity. Mr Cottrell has never invested in, owned or operated any betting company or casino. He has never solicited clients for any betting company or casino. Any suggestion that he was involved in unlawful gambling activity is wholly false.” Harborne and IFX’s representatives told the Sunday Times he had never had any role in the running and operations of IFX and that it “operates in accordance with applicable regulations and legislation across the markets it supports”. A Labour spokesperson said in response: “These reports raise yet more questions about the people bankrolling Reform and Nigel Farage … Farage cannot run from the truth for ever. The mountain of unanswered questions around his finances and judgment is only getting bigger. He needs stop the excuses, come clean with the public.” Explore more on these topics Arron Banks Reform UK Conservatives Investigative journalism Newspapers news Share Reuse this content Most viewed Most viewed UK UK politics Education Media Society Law Scotland Wales Northern Ireland

Jason Arday quit his role as professor of sociology of education this month. Photograph: Christian Sinibaldi/The Guardian View image in fullscreen Jason Arday quit his role as professor of sociology of education this month. Photograph: Christian Sinibaldi/The Guardian Jason Arday Cambridge University defends its mental health support for Jason Arday University says it continued to provide support after resignation of academic, who was found dead on Friday Rachel Hall Sun 16 Aug 2026 10.09 EDT First published on Sun 16 Aug 2026 09.16 EDT Share Prefer the Guardian on Google The University of Cambridge has defended its mental health support for the academic Jason Arday. The university said it had continued to provide Arday with extensive mental health support and security measures, including installing panic alarms and screening racist emails and post, after he resigned from his post as professor of sociology of education this month. He quit after widespread press coverage of accusations of plagiarism and inconsistencies in statements about his career and achievements . A University of Cambridge spokesperson said: “Our support continued in the face of intense public and media scrutiny and after his resignation. Our thoughts and deepest condolences are with Jason’s family and loved ones at this extremely difficult time.” Arday, 41, was pronounced dead after emergency services were called to his home in Battersea, south London, on Friday. When he was appointed professor of sociology of education at Cambridge at the age of 37 in 2023, he was the university’s youngest ever black professor. A vigil in Arday’s memory organised by the campaign group Stand Up to Racism will be held on the steps of the National Gallery in Trafalgar Square, central London, at 6pm on Monday. The group’s co-convener Weyman Bennett said in a statement that Arday’s death was the “result of a racist witch-hunt”. He added: “For more than a week, the rightwing press, politicians and the far right have hounded Jason with the most vicious racism. They are spreading the far-right lie that black people are only appointed because of the colour of our skin, rather than our ability.” View image in fullscreen Prof Deborah Prentice, the vice-chancellor of Cambridge University, said her top priority was ‘supporting our community through this tragedy’. Photograph: Linda Nylind/The Guardian Arday was initially accused of plagiarising another academic’s work for his PhD thesis. He denied the accusations, and an investigation by Liverpool John Moores University this year upheld its decision to award him a PhD. When allegations surfaced in the UK media in July, Cambridge said it had investigated the claims and found no wrongdoing, describing Arday as the victim of a “vile smear campaign to undermine his credibility”. This month, the university announced it would open a fresh investigation after it said it received “new information” about Arday’s qualifications and career. Other elements of Arday’s life story were increasingly questioned, including claims of prodigious money-raising for charity and feats of long-distance running. He was also challenged about whether he was nonverbal until the age of 11, as well as being illiterate until 18. It is understood Cambridge has paused the investigation while Arday’s family are grieving, and will consider whether to reopen it in due course. Academics and politicians have cast doubt on whether Cambridge took Arday’s vulnerability seriously when he was appointed to the ­senior public-facing role in 2023. At the time, the university had been facing criticism for its lack of diversity in senior roles. Prof Simon Baron-Cohen, Arday’s friend and former colleague, told Times Radio he thought the university should proceed with the investigation. “We should see what we learn from it. This is the whole purpose of investigations,” he said. He also questioned whether the media had failed in its duty of care towards Arday, as a vulnerable person with disabilities. He said Arday faced racist abuse and was used as a “lightning rod for a culture war on [diversity, equity and inclusion]”. Simon Woolley, the principal of Homerton College, Cambridge, and Arday’s former mentor, has called for an investigation into the “vicious media onslaught”. In a statement on Saturday, Prof Deborah Prentice, the vice-chancellor of Cambridge University, said her “thoughts and deepest condolences” were with Arday’s family, as well as with colleagues and students in the faculty of education and at Jesus College where he was a fellow. “Supporting our community through this tragedy is the single most important priority for me and my leadership team right now. We will be reaching out to many of you directly, and we are committed to ensuring that no one feels they must face this alone,” she said. A fundraiser launched by the Windrush campaigner Patrick Vernon on Saturday afternoon has raised more than £65,000 to contribute towards funeral and memorial costs and support for Arday’s family. On the crowdfunder’s webpage, Vernon said: “I was one of the people who publicly supported Jason during the recent controversy because I was deeply concerned about the nature and intensity of the attacks directed towards him. I was also subject to media scrutiny for signing the letter of support and challenged in supporting Jason.” Andy Burnham, the prime minister, described Arday’s death as a “tragedy on so many levels” and urged a “moment of reflection”. In a statement issued via Simon & Schuster, which published Arday’s memoir, Great and Unfortunate Things, in the US this week, Arday’s family said they were “in shock to have lost this amazing father, partner, brother, uncle and son”. They added: “Jason was subjected to a campaign of sustained abuse for more than three years since he accepted the role of professor at Cambridge University by those who would leave no stone unturned in their quest to undermine him. The campaign of misinformation was too much for Jason, who was a gentle man and who always wanted to see the best in everyone.” Explore more on these topics Jason Arday University of Cambridge Academics Higher education Universities news Share Reuse this content Most viewed Most viewed Education Schools Teachers Universities Students

Police have detained a man on suspicion of murder and being the owner of a dog dangerously out of control in a public place causing injury. Photograph: georgeclerk/Getty Images/iStockphoto View image in fullscreen Police have detained a man on suspicion of murder and being the owner of a dog dangerously out of control in a public place causing injury. Photograph: georgeclerk/Getty Images/iStockphoto UK news Murder inquiry opens after death of man bitten by dog in West Yorkshire Detectives say 55-year-old man arrested and appeal for anyone who witnessed altercation in Wakefield Hannah Al-Othman North of England correspondent Sun 16 Aug 2026 09.04 EDT Last modified on Sun 16 Aug 2026 11.35 EDT Share Prefer the Guardian on Google Police in West Yorkshire have launched a murder investigation into the death of a man after he was bitten by a dog. Officers were dispatched to Wakefield just after 1.30pm on Saturday, after receiving reports of an altercation a short time earlier on an old trainline footpath. During the altercation a 55-year-old man was bitten by a dog. He was taken to hospital in a critical condition and died shortly after 7pm. A 55-year-old man was arrested on suspicion of murder and being the owner of a dog dangerously out of control in a public place causing injury, police said, adding that he was in custody. Police seized a dog which was understood to have been the one involved in the incident. The homicide and major inquiry team are investigating the man’s death and detectives appealed for any witnesses, including two women who stepped in to help the victim, to come forward. DCI Michael Cox said: “Sadly, a man has died and it is really important that we understand the circumstances of what has taken place. “We know that two people, one named Sophie, stopped to assist the injured man and direct officers. We would urge these two women to come forward to help us with our ongoing inquiries into this tragic incident. “The initial altercation has happened in an area used by walkers and we are urging anyone who has potentially seen or heard any part of the exchange between these two men to please make contact.” Anyone with information can contact detectives via www.westyorkshire.police.uk/livechat or by calling 101, quoting crime reference 13260465524. Photograph: Notorious4life Michigan ‘She is a hero’: 13-year-old survivor of Michigan shooting rampage called 911 Girl called police after she was shot four times in shooting spree that left six dead, including gunman Michael Sainato Sun 16 Aug 2026 11.47 EDT First published on Sun 16 Aug 2026 09.44 EDT Share Prefer the Guardian on Google A 13-year-old girl in Michigan survived being shot four times in a shooting spree that left six people dead – including the suspected attacker – and called emergency help herself shortly before investigators identified the gunman, according to a state police official and her family. Those actions made the teen a “hero”, said a relative of hers as well as two of the dead victims. First responders took the girl to a hospital while she was in critical condition, but she was stable by Saturday, police said. She “called 911 to report that she had been shot” at one of three scenes where the rampage unfolded on Friday, state police spokesperson Lt Ashley Miller said, as reported by NBC News . The shooter had fled before police arrived to the scene, but Miller said investigators were aware of the suspected shooter’s identity. “We were able to identify him right away,” Miller added, without providing details on how. View image in fullscreen Suspect Chad Hickman. Photograph: The Michigan State Police (MSP) Seventh District/AP Chad Hickman, 39, was identified as the suspected shooter. He is alleged to have killed five people across three locations in Michigan’s Missaukee county and was later found dead next to a shooting victim in a wooded area after police launched a manhunt. Police did not release the victims’ names or their relationship to the shooter as of Saturday. They described Hickman’s slain victims as a teenage boy and four adults. A relative, in a Facebook post , identified two of the victims killed as 40-year-old Amanda Everitt and her son, Eric, age 16. David Everitt, Amanda’s father and Eric’s grandfather, wrote that “this world just lost two beautiful people and one is clinging to life”. Everitt asked for prayers for the 13-year-old victim, his granddaughter, “who while shot 4 times still managed to call 911 and identify the shooter”. “She is a hero,” he said. At the first of the three scenes, police said they found the bodies of a 16-year-old boy, a 45-year-old man, a 40-year-old woman, and the 13-year-old girl in critical condition. A 53-year-old deceased victim was found at a second home. And a 29-year-old woman as well as Hickman were both found dead next to each other in the woods. Investigators said they could not immediately determine whether Hickman died by suicide, with an autopsy pending at the time. All had died of gunshot wounds, police said. The suspected shooter had been convicted in 2024 of misdemeanor fourth-degree child abuse, according to court records, and sentenced to one year in prison. The charges stemmed from a complaint filed by his ex-wife, Katie, who had initiated divorce in September 2023. “This situation is heartbreaking for the community and challenging for the investigators involved,” Miller added in a statement on Friday. “It obviously has rocked and crushed [the Missaukee] community at this point,” Miller said. “They’re looking for answers, and they want to know why.” Suspect in Virginia State University shooting found hiding in dorm closet Read more As of Sunday, there had been at least 15 mass murders in the US so far for the year, according to the Gun Violence Archive . Mass murders are cases in which four or more victims are killed. The vast majority of mass murders in the US are carried out with firearms, prompting calls from some quarters for more substantial federal gun control. But Congress over the years has not enacted such restrictions. Police investigate the scene of a shooting on the campus of Virginia State University on Saturday, in Petersburg, Virginia. Photograph: WWBT/AP View image in fullscreen Police investigate the scene of a shooting on the campus of Virginia State University on Saturday, in Petersburg, Virginia. Photograph: WWBT/AP Virginia Suspect in Virginia State University shooting found hiding in dorm closet Suspect, 19, who is not enrolled at the university arrested in connection with shooting of five people, authorities say Michael Sainato Sun 16 Aug 2026 11.42 EDT Last modified on Sun 16 Aug 2026 11.43 EDT Share Prefer the Guardian on Google A young man suspected in connection with the shooting of five people on Saturday on the campus of Virginia State University (VSU) hid in a dormitory closet for more than 14 hours being found and arrested, according to authorities. The suspect – identified as 19-year-old Camron Harris – was found in Seward Hall on VSU’s campus at 4pm, local police Lt James Lamb said, according to the Virginia news outlet WTVR . The shooting occurred at about 1.30am on Saturday. Harris, who is not a student enrolled at the university, was taken to the Chesterfield county jail to be booked on four counts each of malicious wounding and use of a firearm in the commission of a felony. The Henrico, Virginia , resident was being held without bond, and police said additional charges may be filed against him. Chesterfield county police said officers discovered five people with gunshot wounds when they arrived on scene outside campus dormitories. The five victims were transported to local hospitals, with one victim reported to be experiencing life-threatening wound and in a critical condition. The other four victims had non-life threatening wound, according to police. At least one of those victims, a 20-year-old, was confirmed to be a student. Police did not immediately release details about a possible motive, saying the investigation remained ongoing. VSU initially said in a statement the shooting involved “multiple suspects”. The campus was temporarily put on lockdown. VSU later said that authorities did not believe there was any additional, immediate threat to the safety of the school community after the mass shooting. “We recognize the concern this incident has caused among our students, parents, alumni, friends, and the broader VSU community,” VSU said in the statement . “The safety and wellbeing of our students remain our highest priority.” VSU is a public university about 20 miles (32km) south of Richmond that has about 5,700 students, most of whom are undergraduates. Many students on Saturday had just completed the university’s “New Trojans Experience” for incoming students, an event alluding to the nickname for the school’s athletic teams. ‘She is a hero’: 13-year-old survivor of Michigan shooting rampage called 911 Read more As of Sunday morning, there had been more than 300 mass shootings reported across the US so far for the year, according to the Gun Violence Archive . The archive, a nonpartisan reference resource, defines mass shootings as cases in which at least four victims are wounded or killed. The US has perennially registered high numbers of mass shootings, with a considerable portion of those occurring at school and university campuses or activities. Those grim numbers have prompted calls for more substantial federal gun control, though Congress over the years has not implemented such restrictions. https://www.dw.com/en/ukraine-attacks-wi.text: Skip to content Skip to main menu Skip to more DW sites https://p.dw.com/p/5ItPp Experts say the attacks, including this strike on a Wildberries warehouse outside Moscow on July 18, are part of a strategy to 'bring the war home' to Russian civilians Image: Tatyana Makeyeva/AFP Advertisement Early Sunday, a fire broke out in a warehouse belonging to Russia's largest online marketplace , Wildberries, in the town of Podolsk, about 40 kilometers (25 miles) south of Moscow. The fire was the result of a large-scale overnight attack by Ukrainian drones , most of which were intercepted by Russian air defenses. On Friday, Ukraine struck a different Wildberries warehouse, in Tver, north of Moscow. The day before, it had set fire to another warehouse in Salavat, further east. About 20 Wildberries logistics hubs have been under near-daily attack in the past few weeks . At least nine employees have been confirmed dead, and scores injured, while a handful of the storehouses have halted operations. The Moscow-based e-commerce consultancy Data Insight estimates Wildberries has lost as much as 480 billion rubles worth of goods ($5.7 billion/€4.9 billion) and about a third of its warehouse space. Combined damaged to the company and its sellers are estimated as high as 800 billion rubles ($9.5 billion). Putin admits Ukraine's drones are hurting Russia's economy To view this video please enable JavaScript, and consider upgrading to a web browser that supports HTML5 video While Kyiv argues the retailer helps supply Russia's military , Moscow maintains it serves only civilian purposes. Either way, the attacks have been placing an increased strain on Russia's economy. "I think [Ukraine is] going after a choke point," Fabrice Pothier, CEO of the geopolitical consultancy firm Rasmussen Global, told DW. "Wildberries is, in a way, a choke point of Russian society and the Russian economy." Wildberries: Russia's Amazon Wildberries is often described as Russia's answer to the Amazon marketplace . Following Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022 and the ensuing sanctions on Russian trade , many online e-commerce platforms such as Amazon withdrew from the region. In response, Russian authorities permitted so-called parallel imports, essentially allowing Russian companies to sidestep sanctions by importing goods without the consent of the original rights holders. These companies drastically undercut conventional prices, allowing their sales volume to skyrocket. In the case of Wildberries, for example, revenue increased sevenfold between 2021 and 2025. Its competitor, Ozon, offers similarly staggering numbers, with a reported $49.3 million revenue and 59% growth in 2025. Today, Wildberries is the largest e-commerce platform in the country, controlling about half of the respective market. Ozon dominates about 30% of the market. Together, they handle goods and services equivalent to about 8.5% of the Russia's gross domestic product (GDP). Why is Ukraine targeting warehouses? Following the initial attacks in mid-July, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy argued that the warehouses struck were "elements of Russian logistics [...] used to distribute equipment for the war: navigation systems, components for drone production, and other supplies for the Russian army." The Kremlin has consistently rejected this claim. But an analysis by the independent outlet Verska identified "tens of thousands of military and dual-use goods" on the platform between May and August this year, amounting in sales worth hundred of millions of rubles. Why Ukraine is targeting Russia's biggest online retailer To view this video please enable JavaScript, and consider upgrading to a web browser that supports HTML5 video Mykhailo Podolyak, adviser to the head of Zelenskyy's office, said interrupting the flow of military goods to the front lines was just one reason for attacking the company's storage space. Disrupting a business with around 6 trillion rubels in turnover, he told DW, would also affect its creditors, including Sverbank and VTB, both of which are majority state-owned. Not only could this drain state coffers, "if [the company] were to go bankrupt, it will probably have a domino-effect on the economy," as Pothier explained. And "there is a bigger objective at play," the consultant added, "which is to bring back war to its sender" by disrupting civilian life. As many as 400,000 sellers have been affected by the attacks, the Russian Association of Electronic Trading Platforms reported. As a result, civilians are losing sources of income, access to goods and services, and, increasingly, a sense of normality. Wildberries is Russia's largest e-commerce platform, a part of life for millions of people Image: Anastasia Barashkova/REUTERS The platform hosts over 1 million sellers — most of them small- and medium-sized — and reaches some 80 million users each month. But targeting Wildberries was also meant to send a message to Russian elites, according to Podolyak. These include the billionaire Suleiman Kerimov, the diplomat Anton Vaino or politician Alexey Gromov, all of whom are counted in Putin's inner circle, and possibly have varying degrees of involvement with the Wildberries company. What makes Wildberries a target? Wildberries has been investing in massive logistics hubs. The largest span the size of several dozen soccer fields, making them fairly easy — and highly flammable — targets. With hundreds of thousands of retailers affected in the attacks, Wildberries head and co-founder Tatyana Kim has now turned to the government for financial support Image: Evgeniy Razumniy/Kommersant Photo/Sipa USA/picture alliance The company is also said to have incurred substantial debt, with some questioning whether it is still able to service them. According to financial reporting of its main operating entity, RWB LLC, short-term borrowing spiked nearly eightfold between 2024 and 2025. Along with long-term liabilities, Wildberries' debt may be as high as $14 billion, with VTB as the single-largest creditor. Now, the other state-backed creditor, Sberbank, has signaled it is preparing to absorb losses. In response to attack on Wildberries' warehouses, Chief Financial Officer Taras Skvortsov said: "Regarding [Wildberries'] credit quality, there is indeed damage. [...] Their financial condition and potential future cash flow have decreased." Billionaire Tatyana Kim, CEO and co-founder of Wildberries, has now reportedly turned to the government for support. While the government has confirmed talks, no details on a potential decision have emerged. It is expected, however, that VTB will play a key role in rescue efforts. This article was originally written in Russian. It was updated on August 15 to reflect the latest developments. This year, the focus was on women in Yiddish culture. Organizers said more than 300 people from around the world participated in workshops on the Yiddish language, music and dance, as well as youth projects. Participants could take part in dance courses Image: Shendl Copitman/Religion News Service/AP Photo/picture alliance "From the beginning, (the idea was) to present Yiddish culture as something which is alive, and not something that was entirely destroyed by the Shoah (Holocaust)," said Alan Bern, the founder and artistic director at Yiddish Summer Weimar, the body behind the festival. The Yiddish language first emerged in the Middle Ages in the German-speaking regions of Europe and later spread to other parts of Europe in various waves of Jewish migration. It is a Germanic language and partially mutually intelligible with German. In its written form it typically uses a modified form of the Hebrew alphabet. Who speaks Yiddish? In the 1930s, Yiddish was spoken as a vernacular by around 11 million Central and Eastern European Jews. The number of speakers was drastically diminished by the murder of some 6 million Jews in the Holocaust under Nazi Germany. Yiddish also declined as Jewish communities began adopting other languages like English, Hebrew, Russian and French. Now, the language is spoken by between 500,000 and 1 million people. It is mostly spoken as a mother tongue by certain tight-knit ultra-Orthodox communities in North America, Israel and to a lesser extent parts of western Europe. However, enthusiasts from other communities also learn it as a second language out of cultural or academic interest or in an effort to preserve it. Direct investment fell by almost two-thirds year on year to €4.3 billion ($5 billion) in the first half of 2026, according to calculations by the German Economic Institute, or IW, based on Bundesbank data. Compared with the first half of 2024, investment was down by nearly 80%. In the five years before the COVID-19 pandemic, German companies invested an average of €15.8 billion in the US during the first half of each year — almost four times the 2026 level. The IW said the decline continued a trend visible since Donald Trump began his second term in January 2025. Trump has repeatedly used or threatened import tariffs against US trading partners in an effort to secure concessions. The European Union last year struck a deal aimed at avoiding heavier US duties that included a pledge of $600 billion in investment. The IW said uncertainty around such policies was making German companies more reluctant to commit fresh capital in the US. In the first half of 2026, 23.2% of 8,320 reviews ended with protection being revoked or withdrawn, according to a government response to a parliamentary question from the socialist Left Party . The proportion has risen significantly from previous years. In 2025, only 3.7% of reviewed Syrian cases resulted in protection being withdrawn, compared with 3.1% in 2024. Most cases involved the loss of formal refugee status or subsidiary protection — a separate status accorded to refugees but with fewer protections. Syrians who lose protection may still qualify for another residence permit, for example through employment, or potentially for German citizenship. Even without another legal status, deportation to Syria remains difficult because returns require cooperation from Syrian authorities. What is Germany's debate around Syrian refugee returns? Germany resumed deportations to Syria following Assad's fall in December 2024. They were the first deportations since 2011, when Syria's civil war broke out. Earlier this year, Chancellor Friedrich Merz suggested that some 80% of Syrians living in Germany could return to Syria over the next three years. The comments sparked considerable political backlash, with experts arguing the timeframe was unrealistic and others pointing to the large number of Syrians working in Germany's already understaffed medical system . Around 973,000 Syrians were living in Germany at the end of 2023, with some 700,000 having refugee status or subsidiary protection. https://www.politico.eu/article/belgium-.text: Belgium authorities were awaiting crucial air support Sunday to help battle the largest wildfire in the country’s modern history, which has been ablaze since Friday. More than 250 firefighters and emergency personnel worked through the night in the High Fens nature reserve near the German border to stop the spread of the wildfire, which has scorched 3,000 hectares. Firefighters said they are relying heavily on aircraft Sunday to bring the blaze under control, with reinforcements arriving from several European countries. Advertisement Advertisement Belgian federal police helicopters and Dutch aircraft were already operating Sunday morning, repeatedly collecting water from a nearby lake. Additional helicopters from the Czech Republic and Sweden were expected to join later in the day after Belgium activated the EU’s Civil Protection Mechanism. Germany and Norway could also provide aerial support, European Commissioner for preparedness and crisis management, Hadja Lahbib, told AFP. “Thank you to our European partners for the assistance they are providing,” Belgian Prime Minister Bart De Wever wrote on X. Europe has been battling wildfires throughout a summer marked by repeated heatwaves and drought, with blazes forcing thousands to evacuate in Croatia, France, Germany, Greece and Spain. Firefighters in France on Sunday continued battling several wildfires, including one that was nearing the Belgian border . Belgium’s wildfires are tearing through fragile peatlands and pine forests in the High Fens, which were devastated by wildfires during a similar period of heat and drought in 1911. It is Belgium’s largest wildfire since then. No homes have been damaged so far, but residents of two villages have been evacuated and authorities say the fire remains out of control.

https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c87n.text: Image source, Reuters Image caption, The fires broke out within minutes of each other on Sunday afternoon By Emma Rossiter Published 16 August 2026, 17:14 BST Updated 41 minutes ago Two people died and and hundreds were evacuated after two fires broke out "almost simultaneously" on a Greek island near Athens, officials said. About 200 firefighters were working to keep the twin fires from converging on the island of Salamina, which was under a high wildfire risk on Sunday. The first blaze was reported at 14:40 local time (11:40 GMT) near the island's south coast and spread rapidly due to high winds, followed by the second some 20 minutes later in the east. More than 500 people have so far been evacuated by sea, Greek media report. The cause of the fires is not yet known. Five patrol boats have been sent to the area and several other private vessels are being made available for assistance, he added. A number of aircraft and 50 fire engines have also been deployed. The first blaze broke out in a mixed residential and forested area in Peristeria, a southern city on the island, fire official Vasilios Vathrakoyannis said in a statement, followed by the second in the eastern town of Selinia. Firefighters attending the first blaze found two bodies at the scene, he said. At least 10 people suffered burns or showed "symptoms of smoke inhalation", five of whom had been taken for treatment locally, Greek Health Minister Adonis Georgiades said on X. Salamina Deputy Mayor Thodoris Zannis said firefighters were trying to keep the fires from burning over a mountain on the island and meeting to form a single blaze. Image source, EPA/Shutterstock Image caption, A major operation was launched to try to keep the fires from meeting Image source, EPA/Shutterstock Image caption, High winds were said to have caused the fires to spread rapidly The operation is being assisted by water tankers and construction machinery. Salamina sits just west of Athens and has some 37,000 residents, many of them elderly. Firefighters across Europe have been facing a series of wildfires this weekend, including officers in Belgium spending a third day beating back flames in the country's largest nature reserve, Hautes Fagnes. The wildfire - described as the largest in the country's recent history - has more than doubled in size in 24 hours. Meanwhile, at least one person died and dozens were injured in a wildfire that tore through Croatia's coastline overnight on Friday. It was described by Croatia's fire chief Slavko Tucakovic as "one of the worst" blazes in the country's history and saw around 1,200 residents and tourists evacuated. https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c0l5.text: Figure caption, Watch: Emergency services at scene of deadly Virginia State University shooting By Kwasi Gyamfi Asiedu ,Â Reporting from Washington DC Â and Â Hafsa Khalil Published 15 August 2026 Updated 3 hours ago A teenager has been arrested after five people were shot at Virginia State University (VSU) in the early hours of Saturday morning. Camron Harris, a 19-year-old from Henrico in Virginia, was found hiding in a closet on campus after the incident, police told US media. He is not a student at the university. Only one of the five victims was studying at VSU, and all were taken to local hospitals with gunshot wounds. A 21-year-old man remains in a critical condition. The other four, whose ages range from 17 to 23, suffered non-life-threatening injuries, according to police. Local officers initially told the BBC that they believed more than one shooter was involved. VSU, located south of the state's capital Richmond, is one of the country's historically black universities. Officers responded to the incident outside a residence halls at about 01:28 local time (05:28 GMT) on Saturday, the university said. Classes for the new term were set to begin on Monday and campus dormitories opened for returning students on Friday, according to the university's website. Lt James R Lamb of Chesterfield County Police Department told the BBC on Saturday that authorities believed there to be multiple assailants involved. VSU has more than 5,000 students. It and other historically black institutions were created to provide higher education to disenfranchised African Americans, who were otherwise prohibited from attending most colleges. Beállítom Európa legmagasabb Szűz Mária-szobrát avatták fel szombaton a lengyelországi Konotopie településen, írja a BBC . Az 55,6 méter magas betonszobrot Nagyboldogasszony, vagyis Szűz Mária mennybevételének ünnepén szentelték fel. A ceremónia alatt két helikopter rózsaszirmokat szórt a hatalmas koronán álló Mária-alak fölé. A szobor méreteivel a világ legismertebb vallási emlékműveinek egy részét is megelőzi: több mint 17 méterrel magasabb a talapzatával együtt 38 méteres riói Megváltó Krisztus-szobornál. A világ legmagasabb Mária-szobrától ugyanakkor elmarad, a Fülöp-szigeteken található építmény 98 méter magas. A monumentális szobor Lengyelország nagyvárosaitól távol, egy vidéki mezőn épült fel. Ennek oka, hogy az alkotást egy környéken élő milliomos házaspár rendelte meg és finanszírozta. A szombati ünnepségen Krzysztof Wętkowski helyi püspök szentelte fel az emlékművet. A mezőn magányosan álló szobor a távolból – Fotó: Doris Heimann / Picture Alliance / Getty Images A püspök a lengyel PAP hírügynökség szerint arról beszélt, hogy napjainkban sokan kizárólag a földi dolgokra és saját magukra összpontosítanak, a szobor viszont arra hívja az embereket, hogy emeljék tekintetüket Isten és a menny felé. Az avatáson részt vett Lech Wałęsa volt lengyel államfő is. Wałęsa politikai pályafutása során rendszeresen hangsúlyozta katolikus hitének jelentőségét, és a kommunizmus elleni küzdelem idején Szűz Máriát ábrázoló jelvényt is viselt. „Szűz Máriával kezdtem, és Szűz Máriával fejezem be” – mondta a 82 éves politikus az AP-nek. A BBC hozzáteszi, hogy a szobor felavatása közben a katolikus egyház társadalmi befolyása az elmúlt években látványosan csökkent Lengyelországban. Beállítom „Emberfeletti munka folyik Paksnál az Atomerőmű két működő turbinájának üzembentartásáért” – írta Magyar Péter Facebookon. Bejelentette, hogy a szakemberek úgy döntöttek: holnap megnyitják a Ráckevei-Soroksári Duna-ág zsilipjét, és ezzel 20 köbméternyi plusz vizet juttatnak a fő Duna-ágba másodpercenként. A miniszterelnök szerint ezzel két centit nyerhetnek Paksnál. Azt is írta, hogy a keddi és a szerdai nap lesz a kritikus, mert addig további 14-15 centis apadás várható, jelenleg 9 centire vagyunk az utolsó előtti turbina ismételt leállításától. „Ez csak akkor lesz elkerülhető, ha a bárkák süllyesztése meghozza a várt eredményt” – tette hozzá. Csütörtöktől aztán az osztrák vízgyűjtőkre érkezik csapadék, amitől újra emelkedhet a vízszint. „Jelenleg is zajlik a két 80 méteres bárka lassú süllyesztése. Még ma estig elérjük az 1 méteres süllyedési szintet, és holnap reggeltől újra indul a víz beszivattyúzása a hajótestekbe” – írta. A miniszterelnök szombat reggeli élő bejelentkezésében megmutatta, hogy két Airbus H255M honvédségi helikopter megkezdte a Dunakilitiről hozott kéttonnás betonkockák beemelését a Dunába. A két 80 méteres bárkát beállították a kijelölt helyükre, irányított süllyesztésük megkezdődött. A kormány még hétközben ismertette, hogyan képzeli el a paksi vízszint megemelését. Az ideiglenesen lehelyezendő bárkák hasonló hatást fognak kiváltani, mint a fenékküszöb, azaz egy kisebb szakaszon lelassítják és felduzzasztják a vizet. Magyar Péter az élőben arról is beszélt két vízügyi szakemberrel, hogy nyolc szivattyúval emelik be a vizet a bárkák belsejébe, illetve a Duna mindkét partján megkezdődött a fenékküszöb kialakítása. Beállítom Négy embert vettek őrizetbe a horvát hatóságok, mert azzal gyanúsítják őket, hogy szándékosan próbáltak tüzet okozni a Zára (Zadar) megyei Benkovac térségében – írja a Srpske Novine és az MTI. A környéken az elmúlt napokban több szabadtéri tűz is keletkezett, a rendőrség pedig azt is vizsgálja, hogy az elfogottaknak közük lehetett-e ezekhez. A rendőrség közlése szerint lakossági bejelentést kaptak arról, hogy négy ember gyanúsan viselkedik Benkovac környékén. A járőrök ezután rövid időn belül megtalálták és megállították az autót, amelyben a négy ember utazott. Mindannyiukat bevitték a rendőrségre, ellenük büntetőeljárás indult. Az őrizetbe vett személyeket egy házaspár szúrta ki, miközben állítólag gyújtogattak, közülük hárman horvát állampolgárok, a negyedik gyanúsított pedig egy külföldi nő. A nyomozók azt is vizsgálják, hogy a négy ember kapcsolatba hozható-e más, az elmúlt napokban keletkezett tüzekkel. Mint az MTI írja, Benkovac környékén rövid idő alatt több településnél is felcsaptak a lángok, többek között Biljane, Lišane Tinjske, Zapużane, Zagrad és Dobropoljci közelében, valamint Biograd és Privlaka térségében. Péntek este Dugi Otokon is komoly erdőtűz alakult ki , amely a nehezen megközelíthető terepen és a sűrű mediterrán növényzetben gyorsan terjedt. A rendőrség egyelőre nem közölte, pontosan mely tűzesetekkel összefüggésben vizsgálják a gyanúsítottakat. A legsúlyosabb tűz csütörtök este Omiš közelében, Lokva Rogoznicánál alakult ki: a lángok mintegy ezer hektárt érintettek, épületekben és járművekben is károkat okoztak. Egy ember meghalt , több mint negyvenen megsérültek, több ezer embert pedig ideiglenesen evakuálni kellett. Az erdőtüzek több mint 50 magyar turistát is érintettek , a külügy négy sérültről adott tájékoztatást pénteken . Később Orbán Anita külügyminiszter közölte az MTI-vel, hogy minden magyar jól van , senki nem igényelte a konzuli szolgálat segítségét a hazajutásban. Európa-szerte több országban is tombolnak erdőtüzek. A közelmúlt legsúlyosabb erdőtüze pusztít például Belgiumban , két települést is evakuálni kellett. Franciaországban 650 lakosnak kellett elhagynia az otthonát, miután erdőtűz ütött ki az ország délnyugati részén található Landes megyében. https://telex.hu/techtud/2026/08/16/hasz.text: Menü Kereső Az utolsó klasszikus Alfa Romeo használtan a BMW-knél is vonzóbb lehet Techtud Fotó: Hans-Dieter Seufer autóMAGAZIN Zách Dániel Állítsd be a Telexet megbízható forrásnak! Beállítom Ezt a cikket a Telex és az autóMAGAZIN együttműködésének keretében olvashatják. Ha az Alfa Romeónál tudnák, min múlik a márka vagy akár egy típus sikere, biztos ügyesebben bántak volna a kisebb változtatásokkal 2016 óta gyártott Giuliával, vagyis a 952-es modellel. Úgy talán nem bukdácsolt volna olyan sokat ez a szép, arányos külsejű, hosszmotoros sportlimuzin, amiből minden kívánatossága ellenére évente legfeljebb 10-20 ezer példányt adtak el Európában, az Egyesült Államokban pedig még ennyit sem. Közel sem lett olyan népszerű, mint versenytársai, az Audi A4, a BMW 3-as sorozat, vagy a Mercedes C-osztály. Azért furcsa ez, mert a Giulia sikeréhez látszólag minden feltétel adott volt. Az egyszerűbb változatai hátsókerék-hajtásúak és kézi váltósak, de létezik összkerekes és automata váltós kivitel is. A motorkínálatban vannak erős, négyhengeres benzinesek és többféle dízel, a csúcson pedig a tévesen Ferrari-eredetűként emlegetett hathengeres, kétturbós benzinmotor áll, ami több mint 500 lóerős. Az Alfa Romeo évtizedek óta a legfinomabb falatokat tálalja a vevők elé, azok mégis olyan szemérmesen nyúlnak értük, hogy az autók hatalmas értékvesztése túl gyorsan felemészti a használt piaci árakat is. Ez történt az 1997-ben megjelent 156-os esetében, ami szintén csodaszép volt, jó volt vezetni, és ennek ellenére nem lett sikeres a használt piacon. 10-15 év után kevesen akarnak a karbantartására költeni, amikor a motor elkezdi könnyezni az olajat, vagy a hátsó futóműbe kellene néhány új alkatrész. A 2005-től gyártott 159-es technikailag túl bonyolultra sikerült, nehéz is volt, így még gyorsabban eltűnt a süllyesztőben. Ezek után jött a Giulia, ami talán az utolsó hagyományos Alfa Romeo, de egyre több használt példányát hirdetik olcsón Magyarországon. A közel száz, most elérhető példány ára 5 millió forint alatt kezdődik, ezért az összegért a 2,2 literes dízelmotorral szerelt verziók közül válogathatunk. 1-2 millióval drágábban elérhetők a kétliteres, turbós benzinesek, a legdrágább természetesen a Quadrifoglio (négylevelű lóhere), amiért 14–20 milliót kérnek, az újak pedig 32 millió forintba kerülnek. A régi recept szerint A Giulia esetében valószínűleg mindenki felteszi az alapvető kérdést: vajon az imádni való kisugárzásért hosszú távon műszaki problémákkal kell fizetni? És mivel egy használt középkategóriás limuzin megvásárlása más esetekben inkább józan megfontolások alapján történik, adja magát az összehasonlítás a BMW és a Mercedes sikermodelljeivel. Ezek szintén főként négy- és hathengeres benzines és dízelmotorokat használnak, a teljesítményüket hatfokozatú kézi, vagy kiváló minőségű, hidrodinamikus automata sebességváltón keresztül juttatják a hátsó kerekekre éppen úgy, ahogy az Alfa. Fotó: Arturo Rivas Ezen felül viszont arra törekedtek a Giulia fejlesztői, hogy tudatosan sportos és precíz vezethetőséget biztosítsanak az autónak. A kardántengely szénszálas anyagból készül, rendelhető önzáró differenciálmű, aktívan vezérelt osztóművet építenek a viszonylag nagy arányban felbukkanó összkerékhajtású verziókba, és a Continental szállítja a lényegében egyedülálló elektrohidraulikus fékrendszert, ami a vezetési módtól függően változtatja a fékpedál karakterisztikáját. Hasonló rendszert legutóbb a Mercedes kínált a kétezres évek eleji S-osztályhoz, de a feltűnően fejlett SBC-féket tartóssági problémák miatt gyorsan elfelejtették. Az Alfa technikája semmilyen problémát nem mutat, feltéve, hogy a fékbetétek cseréjekor nem hibáznak a szerelők. A nagyfokú precizitásra tervezett futómű-geometria mellett a felfüggesztés nagy része alumíniumból készült a súlycsökkentés érdekében. A szintén nagyon könnyű összkerékhajtási rendszerrel együtt ez biztosítja, hogy szinte egyik Giulia sem nehezebb 1600 kilónál. Ez ugyan pehelysúly ugyan, de a versenytársakhoz képest kifejezetten szép eredmény. Aki a száraz elméletből fejest ugrik a gyakorlatba, és tesz egy kanyargós utazást az Alfával, észre fogja venni, hogy ezek a megoldások rendkívül eredményesek voltak. A típus legtöbb változata kifejezetten sportosan vezethető, és nem is kell feltétlenül az évjárattól függően 510, majd 520 lóerős Quadrifoglióhoz nyúlnunk. A dízelekkel sok gond lehet A 2,9 literes, V6-os biturbómotor nemcsak brutális teljesítményre képes, de lenyűgözően szépen is szól. Ez a motor csak hátsókerék-hajtással párosítható, de aki kicsit keresgél, akár kézi váltós példányokat is találhat. Így a Giulia igazi álomautó lehet még akkor is, ha a 690T motorkódú egység a közhiedelemmel ellentétben nem egy az egyben Ferrari-motor, csupán Gianluca Pivetti főmérnök személye, valamint a lökettérfogat és a főtengely bizonyos paraméterei köthetők a Ferrarihoz. A Giulia csúcsmodelljének menetteljesítménye persze nagyon is ferraris, ezzel a motorral több mint 300 km/óra a végsebessége és kevesebb mint 4 másodperc alatt gyorsul százra. Lényegesen gyakoribb a kétliteres, négyhengeres, turbós benzinmotor. Ez az Alfától származik, és menetdinamikailag a szép idők legendás két-vezérműtengelyeseinek örökségét viszi tovább. A hátsókerék-hajtású 200, az összkerekes 280 lóerős. 6,6, illetve 5,2 másodperc alatt gyorsul velük az autó álló helyzetből 100 km/óra sebességre és a ZF nyolcfokozatú automata sebességváltójával szerelték őket. A kisebb benzinmotorok a pörgetést is szeretik, és ezek is lazán lódítják meg az Alfát, és 240 km/óra körüli végsebességet érhet el velük. Fotó: Hans-Dieter Seufert A dízelek frontján kizárólag egy 2,2 literes, négyhengeres motor vár ránk 136-tól 210 lóerőig terjedő teljesítményszinteken. A fogasszíjjal hajtott vezérlésű motor kifejezetten kulturáltan jár, akár 5 literes átlagfogyasztás is tartható vele, és az alsó fordulatszám-tartományban jelentkező határozott nyomatékával igazi klasszikus utazóautóvá teszi a Giuliát. Ezt a közös nyomócsöves turbódízelt a teljes Fiat/FCA/Stellantis konszernben és azon túl folyamatosan továbbfejlesztették 1994 óta, ezért a kései példányok teljesítik az Euro 6 környezetvédelmi norma előírásait. A típus a mindennapokban a menetdinamikájával a tiszta öröm forrása. Ez már a mély üléspozícióval és a kellemes ergonómiával kezdődik, amit a magasan futó kardánalagút még tovább hangsúlyoz. Alapfelszereltségként jár hozzá egy kissé régimódi infotainment rendszer, ami a BMW mintájára központi tekerőtárcsával vezérelhető. Többféle takarékos és sportos vezetési mód közül is választhatunk, az adaptív futómű viszont csak felár ellenében vagy a magasabb felszereltségi szinteken jár az autóhoz. Az Android Auto és az Apple CarPlay telefonpárosítási lehetőség csak a Giulia 2020-as modellfrissítésével érkezett meg, a régebbi példányok azonban utólag is felszerelhetők ezzel a funkcióval. Az adott gyártási évben szokásos vezetéstámogató rendszerektől puritán az Alfa alapfelszereltsége, bár aligha akadt olyan első tulajdonos, aki alapáron vásárolt ilyen autót. Sok Giulia a finom bőrözésnek köszönhetően lényegesen fényűzőbbnek hat, mint a konkurens német típusok. Sokkal fontosabb azonban a szervizben felmerülő esetleges nehézségek kérdése. A márka típusainak javítására szakosodott, független il Topolino szerviz vezetője, Horváth Áron szerint nem kifejezetten kényes autók a Giuliák, de ez nagyban függ a motorváltozattól is. A 2,2 literes dízelek különösen a 2019. végi modellfrissítés előtti példányok esetében sokféle kockázatot hordoznak. Ilyen például, hogy a motor olajszivattyúja korai kopásra hajlamos, akár 60-80 ezer kilométer után csökkenhet az olajnyomás menet közben, ami a motor végzetes károsodásához vezethet. A másik jelenség szintén a kenési rendszert érinti: rossz minőségű a motor olajfelszívó tölcsérének gyári tömítése, ami miatt levegőt szívhat a rendszer, és ez szintén kenési elégtelenséget okoz. Fotó: Diego Mola A Giulia ráncfelvarrása nem megszüntette ezeket a problémákat, csupán az olajnyomás vált megjeleníthetővé a műszerfali kijelzőn, amit figyelve korán értesülhetünk a gondokról. Egyébként viszont nehéz megbontás nélkül diagnosztizálni a dízelek kezdődő olajellátási hibáit. A vezérlés és a tömítések, illetve az olaj és a szűrők, valamint a hosszbordás szíj és a kartergázban lévő olaj lecsapatására szolgáló alkatrész cseréjével egybekötött olajszivattyú-revízió 600-700 ezer forintba kerül az il Topolinónál. A dízel és a benzines motorok esetében is előfordul az olajnyomás-szabályozó szelep hibája, ami szintén kockázatot jelent, ezért érdemes előre kicserélni, amikor az első erre utaló hibakódot eltárolja az autó számítógépe. Horváth szerint a dízelek a felsoroltaktól függetlenül is nagy kiadást jelenthetnek, de ennek inkább a magasabb futásteljesítményhez van köze. A nagynyomású befecskendező fejek egyenként, kedvezménnyel több mint 193 ezer forintba kerülnek, egy új Garrett turbó szintén több százezres tétel, márpedig a sokat futott dízeleknél egy idő után erre is költeni kell. Ezzel szemben az AdBlue-rendszer, a szelektív redukciós katalizátor (SCR) és a részecskeszűrő (DPF) kevésbé hajlamos a korai meghibásodásra, legfeljebb az Adblue-befecskendező tud elkoszolódni, tette hozzá Horváth. Ezekről korábbi cikkünkben írtunk részletesen . A szervizvezető szerint szélsőséges esetben az is előfordulhat, hogy letörik a dízelmotor kiegyensúlyozó tengelyének váltó felőli vége, ami azonnal tönkreteszi a motort, arra pedig szintén érdemes figyelni, ha a 2,2 literes motor kartergáz-lecsapató egysége meghibásodik, mert emiatt túl sok olajgőz kerülhet a légszűrőházba. Ezt szintén alkatrészcserével lehet javítani. A tűzfalon található hűtőrendszer műanyag légtelenítő csavarja szintén eltörhet, ezt fémre cserélik a műhelyben, a benzinesek turbójának víz- és olajvezeték tömítéseit pedig gyári új alkatrészre. Amikor utóbbiak szivárogni kezdenek, gőz vagy füst szállhat fel a motortérből, vagyis nehéz nem észrevenni a hibát, de a javítás pár tízezer forintos tétel. A szakértő szerint a Giulia optimális motorja a kétliteres benzines, ami alapvetően nem nyűgös szerkezet, de fontos, hogy mindig a megfelelő, gyárilag előírt olaj kerüljön bele, és az autó gazdája ne nyújtsa el a csereciklusokat. Ebben az esetben akár több mint 300 ezer kilométeren keresztül gondtalan lehet az élet a benzines Giuliával. A benzinesek esetében a turbó nyomáshatároló szelepe, az úgynevezett wastegate állítómechanikája hajlamos kikopni. Ilyenkor zörögni kezd, az autó pedig gyengébbé válhat, de járóképes marad, és az egység felújítható. Az összes változat közös automata váltója a ZF nyolcfokozatú szerkezetének egy-egy alváltozata, amely nem hajlamos a meghibásodásra, ráadásul nagyon gyakori konstrukció, sok gyártó használja. A hajtáslánc jellemző hibája lehet a hardy tárcsa elöregedése is, de mivel ezt gyári alkatrészként a kardántengellyel együtt lehet kapni, saját erősített cserealkatrészt ajánl helyette a független szerviz. A 2,9 literes V6-os turbós Alfák ritkák a budapesti szervizben, de a motor alapvetően tartós konstrukció, 200 ezer kilométer után kell benne vezérműláncot cserélni, de erre a motor csörgése is figyelmeztet. A hosszbordás szíj cseréje viszont gyakoribb, ez is több százezer forintba kerülhet, mert alaposan szét kell hozzá bontani az autó elejét. Igazi gond akkor van, ha a legerősebb motor ilyen futásteljesítmény alatt az automata váltót is kifárasztja, mert a váltófelújítással együtt már milliós kiadás a Giulia Quadrifoglio nagyszervize. Összeszerelési minőség Aki abszolút allergiás arra, hogy néha-néha elguruljon a szervizbe, annak talán mégsem a Giuliát kellene választania. Az infotainment rendszer időnként lefagy, az elektronika pedig olykor megbolondul a meghibásodott érzékelők miatt. Utóbbiak azonban szinte mindig hosszadalmas hibakeresés nélkül javíthatók. A csomagtérajtó hibás kábelkötegei vagy az olyan apróságok, mint az üzemanyag-szivattyú hibás reléje szintén okozhatnak bosszúságot a tulajdonosoknak, de ez nem csak az Alfák sajátossága. Fotó: Simon Thompson Horváth szerint előfordul olyan eset is, amikor valóban tönkremegy egy-két parkolószenzor vagy éppen az autó orrában található távolságérzékelő radar. Utóbbi cseréje akár 300-400 ezer forintos tétel is lehet, nélküle viszont nem működik a távolságtartó automatika és a vészfékasszisztens sem. Ugyanígy érdemes ügyelni a tetőablakok mozgatómechanikájára, ami elöregedhet és megszorulhat, így nem lehet bezárni a tetőablakot. A mechanika javítása körülbelül 200 ezer forintos tétel, ami alkualap is lehet a vásárlás előtt. Bár a futómű nagyon igényes konstrukció, nem különösebben hajlamos a korai elhasználódásra, de Horváth szerint ez nagyban függ attól is, hogy az autó gazdája rendesen jár-e rossz minőségű utakon, mert a Giuliát határozottan nem erre tervezték. Tartósan csak azok az esetek zavarók, amikor egyszerre több helyen zörögnek és nyöszörögnek a belső burkolati elemek, vagy váratlan rozsdafoltok bukkannak fel a tetőn, illetve a csomagtérajtón. Úgy tűnik, hogy a problémás zónák megléte és elhelyezkedése a gyártási időszakon belül is változott. Közel azonos korú modellek mutathatnak hasonló gyártási hibákat, de lehetnek akár makulátlanok is. Az Alfa Romeo Giulia limuzinként a középkategória egyik legmaradandóbb formátumára épít, távol a SUV-boomtól és bármiféle elektrifikációtól. Rendkívül kifinomult technika, kombi változat viszont nincs, ami minden bizonnyal megdobta volna az eladásokat. Ennek ellenére a Giulia korosodása közben is kiforrott benyomást kelt, de fontos, hogy átvizsgálás nélkül ilyen autót se vegyünk, mert különösen a dízelek esetében milliós kiadásokat kockáztatunk. https://telex.hu/belfold/2026/08/16/leng.text: Menü Kereső Egy túlélő szerint másodpercek alatt történt a lengyel buszbaleset az M3-ason Belföld Nagy Nikoletta Állítsd be a Telexet megbízható forrásnak! Beállítom „Éjszaka történt a baleset, amikor a legtöbben aludtak a buszon. Beszéltem az egyik emberrel, aki a buszon utazott. Azt mondta, másodpercek alatt történt az egész. Most kórházban van, nagyon jó ellátást kapnak, a szolgálatok gondoskodnak róluk” – mondta Wojciech Tatara, Siedliska falu elöljárója a Polsat News riporterének az M3-ason történt lengyel turistabusz balesetével kapcsolatban. „Az az ember, akivel beszéltem, valószínűleg még nem hagyhatja el egyhamar a kórházat. Sajnos azt is megerősítette nekem, hogy a településünkről biztosan négy ember meghalt” – mondta az elöljáró. A lap azt írja: nem mindenki tudott még kapcsolatba lépni a családjával, néhányan például kórházba kerülhettek, és nem volt náluk telefon, ezért a hozzátartozók folyamatosan próbálják elérni őket. Lengyelország budapesti nagykövetsége egyébként forródrótot hozott létre a baleset halálos áldozatainak és sérültjeinek hozzátartozói számára. Egy zarándoklat résztvevői utaztak hazafelé azon a lengyel turistabuszon, ami egyelőre tisztázatlan okból letért az útról és árokba borult az M3-as autópályán vasárnap éjjel 1 órakor, a rendőrség hivatalos tájékoztatása szerint a balesetben tizenketten meghaltak . A busz utasai lengyel állampolgárok voltak. Maciej Wewiór külügyi szóvivő azt mondta, hét sérült állapota „nagyon súlyos”, további mintegy 40 személy könnyebb sérüléseket szenvedett. A kelet-lengyelországi Rzeszówban működő Kárpátvajdasági hivatal szóvivője a Gazeta Wyborcza szerint azt mondta, vajdaságból indult zarándoklat résztvevői hazafelé tartottak Bosznia-Hercegovinából. A Polskie Radio Rzeszów szerint a Krosnói Kerületi Ügyészség nyomozást indított a buszbaleset ügyében. Az ügyészség szóvivője, Marta Kolendowska-Matejczuk a rádiónak azt mondta, hogy a lengyel igazságszolgáltatás együttműködik a magyar hatóságokkal. „Az ügyészek és a rendőrök már megkezdték a szükséges eljárásokat Lengyelországban. Tervezzük, hogy egy lengyel ügyész részvételével a baleset helyszínén is vizsgálatot folytatunk. Ehhez várjuk Magyarország engedélyét” – áll a közleményben. Siedliska elöljárója azt is mondta, hogy gyerekek is voltak a baleset sérültjei között, de ők nem szenvedtek súlyos sérüléseket. Wojciech Tatara az egyik érintett gyermek édesapjával is beszélt. „A férfinak maradnia kell, a feleségét talán hamarabb kiengedhetik. Ő a feleségével és a gyerekeivel együtt utazott. A gyerekeknek nem esett bajuk, és az alapján, amit mondott, a felesége is nagyjából rendben van. Neki viszont olyan problémái vannak, hogy valószínűleg nem engedik ki, sajnos ott kell maradnia” – mondta. A Radio ZET egy olyan férfit is elért, aki az utolsó pillanatban mondta le a medjugorjei zarándokutat, így végül nem szállt fel arra a buszra, ami balesetet szenvedett. Wiesław családi okok miatt nem indult el, de több ismerőse ott volt a buszon, írja a hvg.hu . Az egyik áldozat férje felhívta a baleset után, és közölte vele, hogy a felesége, aki Wiesław, meghalt. A buszon 57 utas és a két sofőr utazott. Mindkét sofőr életben van, az Országos Mentőszolgálat a Telexnek megerősítette, hogy vizsgálat céljából őket is kórházba szállították. A rendőrség jelenlegi adatai szerint a sofőr feltehetően elaludt. A Police.hu azt írta: a busz sofőrjét őrizetbe veszik. A tűzoltók éjszaka csörlőzéssel és darukkal emelték meg a buszt , hogy ki tudják menekíteni a jármű alá szorult utasokat. A sérülteket helyszíni ellátás után a miskolci, debreceni, nyíregyházi és egri kórházakba szállítottak. További részletek ebben a cikkünkben . Beállítom A NATO szerint minden bizonnyal orosz gyártmányú volt a drón , ami Moldovából repült át, és a spanyol légierő F–18-asai lőttek rá éles rakétát Galac megye felett. Martin O’Donnell amerikai ezredes, az észak-atlanti szövetség műveleti parancsnokságának szóvivője megerősítette: a részleteket még elemzik a szakértők, de az első adatok egyértelműen orosz eszközre utalnak. A NATO Légi Parancsnoksága (AIRCOM) az X-en közzétett beszámolójában részletezte a bevetést: a riasztott két spanyol F–18-as akcióját a spanyolországi Torrejónban működő Egyesített Légi Hadműveleti Központból koordinálták. A most bevetett vadászgépek egy jóval nagyobb spanyol kontingenshez tartoznak, amely augusztus elején érkezett a Mihail Kogălniceanu bázisra: a spanyol légierő mintegy kétszáz fős legénységgel, hét F–18-assal, három NH–90-es drónelhárító helikopterrel és egy A400M légi utántöltő repülőgéppel települt Romániába egy négy hónapos rotációs misszióra. A légtérvédelmi akció után Oana Țoiu külügyminiszter telefonon egyeztetett spanyol kollégájával, José Manuel Albaresszel , és megköszönte a spanyol katonák gyors beavatkozását. Albares azonnal válaszolt, hogy a szövetségesek biztonsága közös ügy, Madrid ezért is küldte el azonnal a kért gépeket Romániába, és továbbra is kész megvédeni a román határt. A spanyol védelmi minisztérium közben az X-en dicsérte a saját katonáit, kiemelve, hogy a pilóták profi munkát végeztek az európai légtér védelmében. A román külügyminiszter a többi NATO-tagállamot is értesítette a történtekről, hozzátéve, hogy a mostani eset után Bukarest hivatalosan is kérni fogja a térség légvédelmének további erősítését. A vasárnapi akció során a járőröző két spanyol vadászgép hajnali 4:44-kor ért a Moldovai Köztársaság felől belépő légi célponthoz, majd 5:01-kor kapott engedélyt a megsemmisítésére. Az elmúlt hetekben ugrásszerűen megszaporodtak a román légteret és partvidéket érintő háborús incidensek. A védelmi minisztérium adatai szerint mindössze 96 óra leforgása alatt több mint száz drónt észleltek a radarok a román határ közelében, miközben az orosz erők az ukrajnai dunai kikötőket támadták. A Fekete-tenger hullámai Costinești, Saturn és Olimp strandjaira sodortak ki katonai dróndarabokat , emiatt a partszakaszt lezárták, és a nyaralókat eltiltották a fürdőzéstől. A vasárnapi lelövés már a negyedik olyan eset idén, amikor vadászgépek semmisítenek meg behatoló drónt Románia felett: július végén három egymást követő napon a román légierő F–16-osai lőttek le harci eszközöket Buzău megye, a Duna-delta és Sulina térségében. http://www.greekherald.com/news/27922007.text: Kiev's 'terrorist plague' spreading across Europe - Russian embassy RT.com 03 Aug 2026, 04:11 GMT+10 Investigators have yet to name any suspects behind the bombing of an Italian restaurant in central Moscow Ukraine's "terrorist plague" is spreading across Europe, the Russian Embassy in Italy has claimed, accusing Kiev of orchestrating the deadly bombing of the Balzi Rossi restaurant in central Moscow. An improvised explosive device detonated outside the Italian restaurant on Kudrinskaya Square on Saturday evening after an unidentified woman allegedly attempted to carry it inside. The security guard who stopped her at the entrance was killed in the blast, along with the courier and at least three patrons attending a private event. Almost two dozen others were injured. The National Antiterrorism Committee has not publicly identified any suspects or linked the attack to Ukraine, another state or any particular organization, while no group has claimed responsibility. In a statement on Sunday, the Russian Embassy in Italy claimed that the "bloody tentacles of Zelensky's terrorist gang" had chosen Balzi Rossi partly to frighten foreigners working in Russia. It described the "Kiev regime" as "another emanation of Al-Qaeda and Islamic State" and accused Western officials who continue to fund and arm Ukraine of enabling terrorism. "It has now become completely clear that the explosion at the Balzi Rossi restaurant and other terrorist attacks in Russia, Monaco and elsewhere show that the Ukrainian terrorist plague is already spreading across Europe, and particularly Italy," the embassy said. Moscow Mayor Sergey Sobyanin described the explosion as a "brutal terrorist act" and vowed that those responsible would be found and punished. Similar attacks blamed on Kiev Russian officials have not announced any arrests or disclosed a suspected motive, but the embassy's allegations follow several previous bomb attacks for which Moscow explicitly blamed Ukrainian intelligence services. Russian journalist Darya Dugina was killed in August 2022 after a bomb was planted in her vehicle. Russia's Federal Security Service accused Ukrainian special services of organizing the assassination and identified Ukrainian national Natalya Vovk as the alleged perpetrator. According to the FSB, she fled to Estonia and has since vanished from public view. A bombing that killed military blogger Vladlen Tatarsky in St. Petersburg in April 2023 bore a more direct resemblance to the Balzi Rossi attack. Darya Trepova carried an explosive device disguised as a statuette into a cafe where Tatarsky was addressing an audience and presented it to him as a gift. The device exploded shortly afterwards, killing Tatarsky and injuring dozens of people. Russian investigators concluded that Trepova had acted on instructions from handlers in Ukraine. She maintained that she had been deceived and believed the statuette contained a listening device rather than a bomb, but a court convicted her of terrorism and sentenced her to 27 years in prison. Kiev never formally admitted involvement, but its former military intelligence chief, Kirill Budanov, later hinted that his agency was behind several high-profile killings inside Russia and promised to " keep killing Russians anywhere on the face of this world." Terrorism beyond Russia The June 29 bombing in Monaco cited by the embassy also involved a woman allegedly recruited by a Ukrainian military intelligence network, according to Russian law enforcement sources. In that attack, a backpack containing an improvised explosive device packed with shrapnel was placed outside a residential building and detonated remotely, injuring Ukrainian businessman Vadim Ermolaev, his partner and her 13-year-old son. The suspected courier, Anastasia Berezovskaya, fled to Ukraine before Interpol issued a Red Notice for her arrest. She was later found shot dead and buried near Kiev. Ukrainian authorities detained two men in connection with her killing, including Vitaly Zhikovich, whom Russian law enforcement sources described as a serving colonel in Ukraine's military intelligence agency. Recordings obtained by RT captured Zhikovich discussing plans to recruit unsuspecting civilians, including women and minors, to transport explosives, sometimes without knowing that they would be killed when the devices detonated.
